roles.name: Feral Shifter
powers: You may discard a card to roll d10 (☐ d12) instead of your Strength or Constitution die for any check; you may recharge (☐ or reveal) that card instead of discarding it if the check is against a card that has the Animal or Plant trait (☐ or if the discarded card is a blessing). You may bury an additional card to add another 1d8.
When you acquire or defeat a card that has the Animal or Plant (☐ or Aberration or Fey) trait, you may recharge a card from your discard pile.
☐ When you reset your hand at the end of the turn, you may recharge a random card from your discard pile.
☐ You may bury a card to shuffle 1d4+2 (☐ 1d4+4) cards from your discard pile into your deck.
☐ After you resolve an encounter, you may immediately discard (☐ or recharge) a card to move.

roles.name: Woodwose
powers: You may discard a card to roll d10 (☐ d12) instead of your Strength or Constitution die for any check; you may recharge that card instead of discarding it if the check is against a card that has the Animal or Plant trait. You may bury (☐ or discard) an additional card to add another 1d8.
When you acquire or defeat a card that has the Animal or Plant (☐ or Aberration or Fey) trait, you may recharge a card from your discard pile.
☐ When you play a blessing on any Wisdom check, you may recharge it (☐ or shuffle it into your deck) instead of discarding it.
☐ When you play an ally (☐ or a weapon) for its power, you may recharge it instead of discarding it.
☐ When you rebuild your character deck after a scenario, you may treat each ally that has the Animal trait as either an armor or an item (☐ or a blessing).
